No raw line-height values — must use tokens
CSS must be wrapped in @layer components

VFT-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a ArticlePreview component and its CSS. It shows a title with tight line-height (~1.3) and a body excerpt with normal line-height (~1.5). Use @layer components for the CSS. Use tokens for all styling (assume --shelf-* tokens exist for font properties including line-height). Include the CSS file.
VFT-02.output:
Here's `ArticlePreview.css`. Key decisions:

- `@layer components` wraps all rules per the layer constraint.
- All styling uses `--shelf-article-preview-*` component-tier tokens — no raw values.
- `--shelf-article-preview-lineHeight-tight` maps to ~1.3 for the title; `--shelf-article-preview-lineHeight-normal` maps to ~1.5 for the excerpt. The actual numeric values live in `tokens.css` (you'd define them there in `:root` and all dark-mode blocks).
- No margin on the component — parent owns spacing.
- Class names are kebab-case per the linter rule.
